final: WITH per_constructor AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS n FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM per_constructor) SELECT p.constructorId, p.nationality, p.n, p.n - a.avg_n FROM per_constructor AS p CROSS JOIN avg_count AS a ORDER BY p.n - a.avg_n DESC LIMIT 10
